messages:
marina: quick question — customer moving to a private/on‑prem deployment in a colo and asking us to handle GPU licensing + colo metering as a single invoice. they want reserved capacity pricing too. what's our recommended billing pattern for Private/VPC? include it in MRR, bill as a true pass-through, or offer an amortized reserved commitment? :thinking:

jasper: short answer: for Dedicated we absorb infra cost under the reserved capacity product. for Private we typically treat third‑party HW + OEM licenses as pass‑through, but we can offer an amortized reserved option if they want predictability. common patterns:
- Platform fee (MRR) + true-up pass-through for actual metered costs
- Platform fee + amortized reserved HW charge (24/36 mo) + optional monthly true‑up for extras
See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/private-pass-through

marina: cc @lucy @kevin — need legal language and sales approach. also any tax/VAT implications to flag?

lucy: we often can't take ownership of OEM entitlements (e.g., some vendor EULAs prevent transfer). two contract patterns work:
1) Customer retains license ownership; Redwood invoices & remits as agent (we need an agency clause + indemnity for license compliance).
2) Redwood purchases and invoices as pass‑through; must include repricing/assignment rights and confirm export/control compliance.
Also: include a tax/VAT line and clear statement on who bears customs/duties. I can draft a clause for both options. :memo:

kevin: Customers dislike surprise variable lines. Sales tip: show both quotes — "amortized reserved" (predictable) vs "actual true‑up" (lower up-front). Most enterprise buyers pick amortized for budgeting. Label it clearly e.g., `Reserved HW (amortized)` or `Third‑party pass‑through (billed actual)`.

jasper: example invoice snippet to include in the quote:
```
Invoice line items:
- Redwood Platform (software + ops): $9,500 / month
- Reserved HW amortization (24 mo): $11,200 / month
- Third‑party licenses (pass‑through, billed actual): $12,400 / month
- Colo/network egress (est, billed monthly): $1,100 / month
```
Note: include `true-up` logic and a smoothing option for the pass‑through so customers don't panic on month 1. also add VAT/TAX placeholder.

ops-bot: Cost calc ready: https://redwood.internal/infra/costs/estimate/6789 — estimated monthly pass‑through (licensing + colo): $12,400; network: $1,100. (automated estimate)

marina: perfect. plan: include amortized reserved option + optional true‑up line in quote. @lucy pls share draft clause by EOD, @kevin pls prepare two price options and customer‑facing language. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
